entries.title: Risk of Rain
entries.definitive_edition: Risk of Rain original on Windows PC, with Risk of Rain Returns as a separate remake entry

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release for the original game; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best way to archive the original 2013 release because it is the original complete route with PC capture/settings flexibility. Risk of Rain Returns is a separate remake entry rather than a replacement row for the original game.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Risk of Rain on Steam or GOG for Windows PC if you want the original 2013 release; play Risk of Rain Returns separately for the remake.

all_releases.reason: primary: original complete route with PC capture/settings flexibility.
skip: same original content family as PC; Windows remains the preferred capture/settings target.

all_releases.fidelity: PlayStation console/handheld route with PS4/Vita cross-platform play.
all_releases.reason: skip: console/handheld route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.
skip: portable route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.
skip: console route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Risk of Rain Returns is a modern remake with more content, but it is a separate game entry; choose original PC only when covering the 2013 release itself.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate the 2013 original with Risk of Rain Returns; the remake is separately represented below.

entries.title: Risk of Rain 2
entries.definitive_edition: Risk of Rain 2 on Windows PC with current DLC through Alloyed Collective

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with all released DLC installed; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC presentation with current DLC support.

primary.version: Current PC release with Survivors of the Void, Seekers of the Storm, and Alloyed Collective
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has the complete current DLC line through Alloyed Collective, PC capture/settings flexibility, and ongoing support. 2K states that future Risk of Rain 2 content and updates will focus on PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PS5 rather than Xbox One, PS4, or Switch, so PC is the safest complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Risk of Rain 2 on Steam for Windows PC and install Survivors of the Void, Seekers of the Storm, and Alloyed Collective before starting a complete archive run.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with current DLC support through Alloyed Collective.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete current content route with ongoing support and PC capture/settings flexibility.

all_releases.fidelity: Cloud-streaming route, now discontinued with Stadia.
all_releases.reason: skip: discontinued cloud route and not appropriate for current archival play.
skip: useful access routes, but 2K says future content will no longer release on Switch, PS4, or Xbox One.

all_releases.fidelity: Current-generation console routes with future-content focus alongside PC.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console routes, but Windows PC remains the main capture/settings target.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Older console routes are no longer receiving future content, so PC is the safest complete route even though PS5 and Xbox Series are also current-support targets.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not choose Switch/PS4/Xbox One for a completion-focused archive run because future content support has ended for those platforms.

entries.title: Risk of Rain Returns
entries.definitive_edition: Risk of Rain Returns on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route for the remake because it has the complete modernized remake with PC capture/settings flexibility. The Nintendo Switch version is a documented portable route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over PC is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Risk of Rain Returns on Steam for Windows PC and play the current native PC build as the remake route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC remake release with higher-resolution visuals, new music, improved networking, and added content.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete remake route with PC capture/settings flexibility.
skip: portable route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive gameplay content is documented between PC and Switch for the remake.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a remake of the first Risk of Rain, not a patch/port row for the 2013 original.
